title: Samāgam
subtitle: The Gathering
description: Samāgam  is an open stage that brings students together through the spirit of Bharat. It features talks, music, dance, storytelling, and other expressions inspired by our paramparā  . It is a space to share, learn, and celebrate our Saṃskṛti, while discovering the many traditions, art forms, and ideas that make up Bharat's rich cultural heritage.
highlights: An evening dedicated to celebrate the richness of Bharatiya culture and heritage.
Talks by students on history, culture, and philosophy
Open mic sessions for poetry, storytelling,  and singing
